nodes.title: Three-point bend of the US-stock 22 x 20 tube (I1 buys, H1 runs)
nodes.procedure: Span 0.80 m on two 22 mm dowels, load at centre in 0.5 kg steps to 4 kg, dial gauge to 0.01 mm; E = F L^3 / (48 I delta) with I = 3.645e-9 m4. Pass band for the recommended design: E >= 70 GPa.

nodes.title: Torsion of the same tube
nodes.procedure: Clamp 0.40 m of tube in two printed V-blocks at one end, 0.30 m lever arm at the other, 0.5-2 kg, measure twist with a laser pointer on a wall 3 m away; G = T L / (J theta), J = 7.29e-9 m4.

nodes.title: Tap test of one fin quarter (tube + block + half-fin + motor + prop + brace)
nodes.procedure: Block clamped in a vice via a core offcut; tap the motor bell in y and x; phone accelerometer or FC raw IMU at 1 kHz; FFT peaks vs 1P/2P at hover, cruise, max.

nodes.title: Foam-board face coupon
nodes.procedure: Three 50 x 300 mm strips per layer count, four-point bend, span 250 mm, load to failure: face allowable and D. Weigh 0.1 m2 for the areal mass.

nodes.title: Block proof in a core offcut
nodes.procedure: Block bonded on a spar stub in a 0.15 m core offcut; 0.30 m tube in the bore; hang 18 kg at 0.17 m lever (30 N m > design 20.3 N m) for 1 min; no creak, no bond line crack.

nodes.title: Bifilar swing of one prop
nodes.procedure: Two 0.5 m threads at the blade tips; period of 20 swings; I = m g d^2 T^2 / (16 pi^2 L).
